AFTER COURSE CHOICE  ·  Searchable dropdown, allow multiple selections. Show only the student's course options, grouped by topic.
OTHER MATHEMATICS  ·  Optional separate short-answer field (free text), including techniques outside the course. Ask for teacher discussion; do not auto-reject.
ALSO OFFER  ·  'I'm not sure yet'. Selecting many techniques is NOT evidence of a better IA; students must justify what each would achieve.
COURSE VERSION  ·  Initial list is for the current programme (first assessment 2021). Review for the revised syllabus first assessed in 2029.
